repos.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
repos.intro: This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents.
features: Modern Browser APIs : Helping models correctly structure APIs they frequently misuse.
Performance & Accessibility : Preferring platform-level APIs that can be optimized by the browser and include built-in accessibility afforda…
Responsible Fallbacks : Guiding models to use sensible, lightweight fallbacks instead of heavy polyfills or legacy libraries.
repos.description_zh: 讓您的 coding agent 掌握最新的 Web 最佳實踐
repos.intro_zh: 此 repo 是 GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance 的原始碼儲存庫，包含用於撰寫、校準與評估其內容的程式碼與文件。
features_zh: Modern Browser APIs：幫助模型正確建構它們經常誤用的 API。
Performance & Accessibility：優先使用可由瀏覽器優化並包含內建無障礙功能（accessibility affordance）的平台級 API。
Responsible Fallbacks：引導模型使用合理且輕量化的 fallback，而非沉重的 polyfills 或舊版函式庫（legacy libraries）。
repos.description_src: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

repos.description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
repos.intro: Codex Security helps you find, investigate, and fix vulnerabilities in your code. Use its security workflows in Codex, or automate them with the @openai/codex-security CLI and TypeScript SDK.
features: Scan repositories, selected paths, or Git changes. Deep scans repeat Standard scans and return their deduplicated findings.
Validate candidate findings, generate patches, and verify existing fixes.
Draft SECURITY.md policies and save threat models for later review.
Browse saved scans and findings, identify duplicates, assess severity against your own rubric, and suggest owners from source and Git histor…
Preview third-party scanner findings, save them locally, or publish supported reports to Codex Security Cloud. Scanner import guides .
Track findings in Linear, Jira, or GitHub, publish completed scans, or export SARIF, JSON, and CSV. Integration workflows .
repos.description_zh: OpenAI 的 Codex Security CLI 與 TypeScript SDK，用於尋找、驗證並修復安全性漏洞。npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
repos.intro_zh: Codex Security 協助您在程式碼中尋找、調查並修復漏洞。您可以在 Codex 中使用其安全性工作流程，或透過 @openai/codex-security CLI 與 TypeScript SDK 將其自動化。
features_zh: 掃描 repositories、選定的路徑或 Git 變更。Deep scans 會重複執行 Standard scans 並回傳其去重後的結果。
驗證候選結果、產生 patch，並驗證現有的修復。
起草 SECURITY.md 政策並儲存威脅模型以供日後審查。
瀏覽已儲存的掃描與結果、識別重複項、根據您自己的標準評估嚴重程度，並從原始碼與 Git 歷史中建議負責人…
預覽第三方 scanner 的結果、將其儲存至本地，或將支援的報告發佈到 Codex Security Cloud。Scanner 匯入指南。
在 Linear、Jira 或 GitHub 中追蹤結果、發佈已完成的掃描，或匯出 SARIF、JSON 與 CSV。整合工作流程。
repos.description_src: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security

repos.description: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
repos.intro: The open-source AI coding agent for your terminal, editor, desktop, browser, and chat.
features: Agentic out of the box — Auto-Memory, Auto-Skills, SubAgents, Agent Teams, and MCP. Dynamic workflows, zero setup.
Open-source, inside and out — The framework and the Qwen models are open-source. They evolve together. No vendor lock-in.
Multi-protocol — Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Qwen APIs. Any third-party provider or local model (Ollama / vLLM).
Beyond the terminal — IDE plugins, Desktop app, Web UI, SDKs, and chat integrations (Telegram / DingTalk / WeChat / Feishu).
repos.description_zh: 一款運行在您終端機中的開源 AI coding agent。
repos.intro_zh: 適用於您的終端機、編輯器、桌面、瀏覽器與聊天工具的開源 AI coding agent。
features_zh: 開箱即用的 Agent 能力 — 包含 Auto-Memory、Auto-Skills、SubAgents、Agent Teams 與 MCP。動態工作流，零設定。
從內到外皆為開源 — 框架與 Qwen 模型皆為開源。兩者共同演進。無供應商鎖定。
多協定支援 — 支援 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 與 Qwen API。支援任何第三方供應商或本地模型 (Ollama / vLLM)。
超越終端機 — 提供 IDE plugins、Desktop app、Web UI、SDKs 以及聊天工具整合 (Telegram / DingTalk / WeChat / Feishu)。
repos.description_src: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.

repos.description: LLM Inference Engine for Metal, CUDA and Vulkan.

categories: 機器學習 / 深度學習
repos.description_zh: 用於 Metal、CUDA 與 Vulkan 的 LLM 推論引擎。
repos.intro_zh: TensorFold 在 Apple Silicon 與 NVIDIA GPU 上透過 Zig binary 提供語言模型服務。該引擎會讀取 checkpoint、對請求進行 tokenization，並直接執行 Metal 或 CUDA kernel。服務過程不需要安裝 Python 或 MLX。
repos.description_src: LLM Inference Engine for Metal, CUDA and Vulkan.

repos.intro: Skills encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices that senior engineers use when building software. These ones are packaged so AI agents follow them consistently across every phase of development.
repos.description_zh: 適用於 AI coding agents 的生產級工程技能。
repos.intro_zh: 這些技能封裝了資深工程師在開發軟體時所使用的工作流程、品質閘門（quality gates）與最佳實踐。透過這些封裝，能確保 AI agents 在開發的每個階段都能一致地遵循這些規範。
repos.description_src: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

repos.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
repos.intro: An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them.
features: Open internals. Components are built to be composed at any level, not locked behind a closed top-level API.
No styling lock-in. Astryx authors its styles with StyleX, but that's invisible to consumers.
Customize without wrapping. A theme is a set of CSS custom property overrides, so a designer can make Astryx unmistakably theirs without for…
Built for people and agents. The API, docs, and CLI are designed together so a person and an AI assistant build the same way, from the same…
repos.description_zh: 一個完全可自訂且已為 Agent 就緒的開源設計系統
repos.intro_zh: 一個完全可自訂，且專為現今開發模式打造的開源設計系統：由人類與與其並肩工作的 Agent 共同開發。
features_zh: 開放內部實作。組件的設計旨在任何層級進行組合，而非被鎖在封閉的高階 API 之後。
無樣式鎖定。Astryx 使用 StyleX 撰寫樣式，但這對使用者來說是透明的。
無需封裝即可自訂。主題是一組 CSS custom property 的覆寫，因此設計師可以讓 Astryx 展現出鮮明的個人風格，而不必...
為人類與 Agent 而生。API、文件與 CLI 是同步設計的，因此人類與 AI 助手能以相同的方式、從相同的...進行開發。
repos.description_src: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready

repos.description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
repos.intro: A modular, self-hostable workspace for AI coworkers. Choose your models. Bring your agents. Own your infrastructure.
features: A computer per person : the supervisor gives each person their own container, with a folder and browser profile for each of their Bots.
A shell, not just a browser : a Bot can run a command in its workspace, install what it needs, and process a file it saved.
The gateway is the only way in : it resolves the target from a server-held snapshot, evaluates the policy, writes the audit row, and only th…
CEL policy, fail closed : rules can inspect tool.name , intent , bot.id , actor.id , page.url , page.host , element.* , key , command , file…
Watch what it is doing : the screen shows what a Bot is looking at, and the Activity list under it shows what it ran, read and saved in this…
Take the wheel : a Bot that hits a login wall or a 2FA prompt asks for help.
repos.description_zh: 開源 AI 同事，每位同事都擁有專屬的電腦：包含瀏覽器、檔案與工具，且所有動作皆在發生前決定並在發生後記錄。支援任何 AG-UI agent。
repos.intro_zh: 一個模組化、可自我託管的 AI 同事工作空間。選擇您的模型。帶入您的 agents。掌控您的基礎設施。
features_zh: 每人一台電腦：管理者為每個人分配專屬的 container，並為其每個 Bot 提供獨立的資料夾與瀏覽器設定檔。
不僅僅是瀏覽器，更是 shell：Bot 可以在其工作空間中執行指令、安裝所需套件，並處理其儲存的檔案。
Gateway 是唯一的入口：它從伺服器持有的 snapshot 中解析目標、評估 policy、寫入稽核紀錄，然後才……
CEL policy，預設拒絕 (fail closed)：規則可以檢查 tool.name、intent、bot.id、actor.id、page.url、page.host、element.*、key、command、file…
監控其行為：螢幕會顯示 Bot 正在查看的內容，下方的 Activity 列表則顯示其在此期間執行、讀取與儲存的內容。
接管控制權：當 Bot 遇到登入牆或 2FA 驗證提示時，會請求協助。
repos.description_src: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
